title: DefaultGNN: A Dual-Perspective GNN Framework for Predicting Corporate Default from Buyer-Seller Transaction Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.25542v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Corporate default prediction is a core problem in financial risk management, yet traditional credit models rely heavily on financial statements that are often sparse or unavailable for many firms. Corporate transaction networks offer a complementary view of real economic activity, but how risk propagates through buyer-seller relationships remains underexplored. We conduct a large-scale empirical study using real-world electronic tax-invoice data spanning six years that links transaction histories with default events, revealing that transaction-driven risk is both role-dependent (buyer or seller) and scale-dependent. Based on these findings, we construct multiplex buyer-view and seller-view transaction networks and propose DefaultGNN, a dual-perspective graph neural network-based framework for corporate default prediction. translated_title: DefaultGNN：一种基于买卖双方交易网络预测企业违约的双视角图神经网络框架
translated_abstract: 企业违约预测是金融风险管理的核心问题，然而传统的信用模型严重依赖财务报表，而许多企业的财务报表往往数据稀疏或无法获取。企业交易网络为真实经济活动提供了互补的视角，但风险如何通过买卖关系进行传播仍未得到充分研究。我们利用跨越六年的真实电子税务发票数据开展了大规模实证研究，该数据将交易历史与违约事件相关联，揭示了交易驱动的风险既依赖于角色（买方或卖方），也依赖于规模。基于这些发现，我们构建了多路的买方视角和卖方视角交易网络，并提出了DefaultGNN，一种基于双视角图神经网络的企业违约预测框架。DefaultGNN整合了两种视角，以建模风险如何在交易关系中流动，取得了显著的性能提升。
tldr: 该论文基于六年真实电子税务发票数据发现交易风险具有角色依赖性和规模依赖性，进而提出双视角图神经网络框架DefaultGNN，通过整合买方与卖方两种交易网络视角来建模风险传播，从而更准确地预测企业违约。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DefaultGNN, a dual-perspective GNN framework that integrates buyer-view and seller-view transaction networks built from six years of real tax-invoice data to model role- and scale-dependent risk propagation for more accurate corporate default prediction.
